name: @ra/cluster-packaging
description: RAW AROMACHEM packaging cluster (packaging schema): CRUD over product category/master/SKU catalog, packaging material + BOM, package orders + items, filling sessions + details, and finished-good batches + consumption. Drives the package-order, filling, and FG-batch flows and emits packaging.order.created / packaging.filling.done / packaging.fg_batch.created. Exposes the PACKAGING_LOOKUP cold-read port.
